items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: And they hooked up playing man... I called Bert. I said, “Bert, I’m having trouble trying to get this little kid to play the high A.” And he told me, yeah, he told me what fingering to use.

ctx.x: That’s a shame he went so early.

You aren’t lying man. But the first time I heard Cannonball we went to Florida A&M, our school went down to Florida and we had a saxophone player by the name of Bert Robinson, I got to get this on your tape.
